lines.trans: Unfold the paper along the original crease so the charcoal lines stay crisp, {M2}.
Oh, what a charming portrait—five young friends sitting beneath our courtyard shade tree!
There is my aunt pouring tea beside the open shutters of Room Nine!
And on the left with a violin under his chin sits number ten!
Beside him sits a young man holding this exact brass compass—my old map professor!
Who are the other two smiling neighbours holding plates of cake at table one?
Look at the tiny caption pencilled along the lower margin of the sketch, {M2}.
Friday Tea Crew, May: five chairs today, twenty-four chairs when we meet again!
They dreamed of twenty-four chairs around these stones thirty summers before you ordered them!
Do you hear that, {F3}?! My accidental chair order fulfilled a thirty-year prophecy!
Let us frame this charcoal sketch right above the walnut piano, {M2}.
Wait—look under the tissue paper at the very bottom of the tin box!
